```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# position table, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The position path is a contract-checked pipeline target, read from the
# targets store rather than the DuckDB (decision 0041).
pp <- targets::tar_read(position_path, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
rec_levels <- setdiff(harmonized_position_levels(), "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: stay-by-group
# A draftee counts when the draft record links him to an NFL position and he
# has a recorded college group; the overall share is every such draftee together.
dr <- pp |>
  filter(
    nfl_linked,
    !is.na(nfl_group), nfl_group != "Position not recorded",
    college_groups > 0, !is.na(college_modal_group)
  )
nfl_overall <- mean(dr$nfl_group == dr$college_modal_group)
nfl_stay <- dr |>
  group_by(college_modal_group) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    stayed = sum(nfl_group == college_modal_group),
    stay_share = stayed / draftees,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    college_modal_group = factor(
      college_modal_group,
      levels = college_modal_group[order(stay_share)]
    ),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s of %s kept their group in the NFL (%.1f%%)",
      college_modal_group,
      formatC(stayed, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      formatC(draftees, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      100 * stay_share
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each college group's share of draftees who played the same group in the NFL,
# against the overall share (dashed line).
p <- ggplot(nfl_stay, aes(100 * stay_share, college_modal_group)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 88, xend = 100 * stay_share, yend = college_modal_group),
    colour = "gray75",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100 * nfl_overall, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = college_modal_group,
      tooltip = tip,
      data_id = as.character(college_modal_group)
    ),
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * stay_share)),
    hjust = -0.3,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    limits = c(88, 103),
    breaks = c(90, 95, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Draftees who kept their college position",
    subtitle = "Share keeping their group; axis starts at 88%",
    x = "Share who kept their group (%)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "position-group-college-to-nfl", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: flow
# Where each college group's draftees played in the NFL: every row sums to one
# hundred percent of that group's draftees.
flow <- dr |>
  count(college_modal_group, nfl_group, name = "moves") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    college_modal_group = rec_levels,
    nfl_group = rec_levels,
    fill = list(moves = 0L)
  ) |>
  group_by(college_modal_group) |>
  mutate(row_share = moves / pmax(sum(moves), 1L)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    college_modal_group = factor(college_modal_group, levels = rev(rec_levels)),
    nfl_group = factor(nfl_group, levels = rec_levels)
  )

p_flow <- ggplot(flow, aes(nfl_group, college_modal_group, fill = row_share)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "College %s, NFL %s: %s draftees (%.0f%% of the %s group)",
        as.character(college_modal_group),
        as.character(nfl_group),
        formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
        100 * row_share,
        as.character(college_modal_group)
      ),
      data_id = paste(college_modal_group, nfl_group)
    ),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F3F4F6",
    high = "#374151",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x),
    name = "Share of the college group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Where each college group's draftees played",
    subtitle = "Share of each college group by NFL position group",
    x = "NFL position group",
    y = "College position group",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
card_interactive(p_flow)
```
